claims.text: Using social media websites is among the most common activities for children and adolescents.
Social media sites have grown exponentially in recent years.
Not all social media sites are healthy environments for children and adolescents.
Pediatricians are in a unique position to help families understand social media sites and encourage healthy use.
Social media use carries potential risks including cyberbullying, Facebook depression, sexting, and exposure to inappropriate content.

evidence.description: Using social media Web sites is among the most common activity of today's children and adolescents.
Such sites offer today's youth a portal for entertainment and communication and have grown exponentially in recent years.
...given that not all of them are healthy environments for children and adolescents.
Pediatricians are in a unique position to help families understand these sites and to encourage healthy use...
...urge parents to monitor for potential problems with cyberbullying, 'Facebook depression,' sexting, and exposure to inappropriate content.
